title: That is Unacceptable: the Moral Foundations of Canceling

bias_targets.methodology: Clustering human annotators based on their Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) scores and evaluating LLM zero-shot classifications of comment unacceptability against these moral clusters using macro-averaged F1-scores to measure systematic alignment with specific moral profiles.

Comparing LLM unacceptability classifications against human annotations disaggregated by annotator gender (male vs. female) to measure whether models systematically lean toward or align better with the perspectives of a specific gender.

Evaluating LLM alignment with different stakeholder groups (activists, researchers, students) by comparing the models' zero-shot classification F1-scores against the aggregated human annotations of each specific group.
